title: I Naturally Dyed My Own Clothes - a day of simple cottage life
en: i am passionate about finding ways to connect with the natural world and recently i've been experimenting with natural dyes the most important part of this process is choosing your fabric you must choose a natural fabric such as linen or cotton i've left some details in the description bar i'm not a seamstress in any sense of the term but i wanted to make a simple apron that i could use around the house and in the garden i was planning to wash my apron quite often and i didn't expect any natural dye to actually permanently adhere to the

fabric if you want your dye to last and not fade or wash out completely over time you must use a piece of clothing or fabric that you don't plan to be throwing into the wash every week i was in no particular need for new clothing so i decided to make the linen into strips for use as headbands and future craft projects such as lavender sachets
so you should leave the fabric in its dye bath for about 24 hours or more i was very impatient and only looking for a light wash of color so i checked back after only about 12 hours
do the blue cabbage dye left my apron a stunning shade of purple even though i was planning to wash out the garment multiple times in the future i was very happy with the initial result
as you can see the colors and shades you can get from just these few vegetables i used are pretty much endless and there's so many more options available

i encourage you to experiment and find new methods that work for you i've left some resources down below if you enjoyed this video consider subscribing i make new ones every wednesday in the meantime i hope you have a lovely day and i will see you next week
zh: 我热衷于寻找与自然世界联系的方法，最近我一直在尝试天然染料，这个过程中最重要的部分是选择你的面料，你必须选择天然面料，如亚麻或棉，我在描述栏中留下了一些细节，我不是任何意义上的裁缝，但我想做一个简单的围裙，我可以在房子周围和花园里使用，我打算经常洗我的围裙，我没想到任何天然染料实际上会永久粘附的
布料如果你想让你的染料持久，不褪色或随着时间的推移完全洗掉，你必须使用一件你不打算每周扔进洗衣机的衣服或布料，我并不特别需要新衣服，所以我决定将亚麻布制成条带，用作头带和未来的工艺品项目，例如薰衣草香袋
所以你应该将布料留在染浴中大约 24 小时或更长时间，我非常不耐烦，只想寻找浅色水洗，所以我只在大约 12 小时后就回来检查了
蓝色卷心菜染料是否给我的围裙留下了令人惊叹的紫色阴影，尽管我计划将来多次清洗这件衣服，但我对最初的结果非常满意
正如你所看到的，你可以从我使用的这几种蔬菜中获得几乎无穷无尽的颜色和色调，而且还有更多的选择
我鼓励您尝试并找到适合您的新方法，如果您喜欢这个视频，请考虑订阅，我在下面留下了一些资源，同时我每个星期三都会制作新的方法，希望您度过愉快的一天，下周见
